current_point.claim: 利用区块稀疏等技术实现Museformer的高效编码，相比全注意力模型具有更低的存储和计算复杂度，可建模超过3倍长的音乐序列且运行速度更快。
current_point.claim_en: Achieve efficient implementation of Museformer with techniques such as block-sparse, resulting in lower storage and computation complexity than full attention, and the ability to model over 3 times longer music sequences with a faster running speed.
